summary.text: David Schupbach is the Green Party candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Republican Joy Goeben and Democrat Justin Schumacher.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Schupbach said his campaign aims to lower costs for Wisconsin families, including housing, health care, child care and energy, and to have wealthy individuals and large corporations pay more by closing tax loopholes.
He also called for ranked-choice voting, independent redistricting and campaign finance reform.
He said he supports a millionaire's tax to fund education and roads, expanded credit and farmland protection for family farms, and more attainable housing.
